dedupe_keys.name: escape inventories for 33 lithium ion battery recovery technologies

description: ESCAPE publishes calculated embodied-energy and carbon-footprint values for thirty-three literature-derived lithium-ion battery recovery processes. The producer separates thermal treatment, mechanical treatment, chemicals and water use. Two Excel tables represent the processes as described in their source studies and an alternative with changed water grades for dilution and washing. Mendeley Data provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The coverage is a set of process technologies, not a geographic monitoring network or time series. Many source processes were developed at laboratory scale, and the calculations preserve source-specific assumptions; comparisons therefore do not establish commercial-scale costs or recovery performance. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying environmental coefficients or testing scenario assumptions in battery-recycling and material-flow simulations. model-epa-warm-waste-reduction-model is a related assessment tool, with no verified direct mapping of its processes to these thirty-three inventories. No spreadsheet calculations were executed.
